chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated that from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I said to Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام: I enter the masjid and find that the Imam has already gone into ruku' and the people have gone into ruku', so I am unable to give the adhan, perform the iqamah, and say the takbir. He said to me: When that is so, then enter with them and count it, for it is among the best of your rak'ahs.

Ishaq said: When I heard the adhan for maghrib while I was sitting at my door, I said to the servant: Go see, has the salat been commenced? He came back to me and said: Yes. So I got up quickly and entered the masjid, and I found that the people had already gone into ruku', so I performed ruku' with the first row that I reached and counted it. Then after the conclusion, I prayed four rak'ahs and then departed. Thereupon, five or six of my neighbors from the Makhzumis and the Umayyads came up to me and said: O Aba Hashim, may Allah reward you well for yourself; for by Allah, we saw contrary to what we had thought about you and what had been said to us. I said: And what was that? They said: We followed you when you rose for the salat while we thought that you did not count the salat with us, but we found that you had counted the salat with us and had prayed with our salat. May Allah be pleased with you and reward you well.

He said: So I said to them: Glory be to Allah, is such a thing said to one like me? He said: Then I came to know that Abā 'Abdillāh عليه السلام only instructed me so because he feared for me this and things like it.

key_terms.أُؤَذِّنَ: to recite the adhan, the call to salat
key_terms.أُقِيمَ: to perform the iqamah before salat
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual salat being performed in congregation
key_terms.الِانْصِرَافِ: the completion or dispersal after the congregational salat
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the masjid where congregational salat is joined
key_terms.جِيرَانِي: my neighbors, indicating the surrounding social community
key_terms.رَكَعَ: entered ruku', the bowing position in salat
key_terms.وَاعْتَدَّ بِهَا: count it as a valid rak'ah

ai.seo_question: Can a person join the congregational salat in ruku' and count that rak'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of joining congregational salat when the Imam is already in ruku', instructing the person to join immediately and count that rak'ah. It also shows a practical social benefit of doing so, as the Imam's guidance protected the narrator from suspicion and preserved outward harmony with others.
